title: [Subcontracting] Bug 641399: Move Subcontracting Transfer Orders action out of Entries sub-group
summary: Subcontracting Transfer Orders action moved from the Entries sub-group to the Order group level on production order pages, correcting its placement since transfer orders are documents rather than ledger entries.
key_points: Relocated Subcontracting Transfer Orders action in four page extensions
Changed placement from Entries sub-group to Order group level
Action now appears alongside Subcontracting Order Lines instead of ledger entry actions
Affects both card and list versions of Released and Finished production order pages
Ledger entry actions remain in the Entries group
quote: Move it up to the Order group level next to Subcontracting Order Lines on all four production-order pages
